page.overview:
Who is Kawarama Senju?

During the war-torn era before the creation of the shinobi villages, Kawarama was one of the many young shinobi who were put on the battlefield to fight. At a young age, he became a shinobi with outstanding talent, but nevertheless became a casualty to the Uchiha and the Hagoromo clan during the ever-waging battles.

Kawarama was a young boy with a head of light-coloured hair (depicted as light-brown in the anime), and black eyes. He also had an x-shaped scar on his right cheek. He wore a simple attire consisting of a black coloured shirt, and white haori with black trimmings.

Although being merely seven years old, Kawarama managed to become a shinobi with outstanding prowess on the battlefield.
